links.outcome: Consistency of LLM answers across three repeated runs on Korean dental licensing questions
links.effect: GPT-4o accuracy 81.1% vs Gemini Advanced 76.6% (P=0.013); GPT-4o showed greater consistency across attempts. Consistency difference between models in cross-solving was not significant (P=0.578).
links.quote: GPT-4o achieved significantly higher average accuracy than Gemini Advanced (81.1 % vs. 76.6 %, P = 0.013) and showed greater consistency across attempts.

unlisted_practices: Cross-model solving of LLM-generated exam questions to assess interpretation differences
LLM-generated question creation for dental education

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (GPT-4o and Gemini Advanced) on questions from the Korean National Dental Licensing Examination, evaluating accuracy and consistency without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
